The airport primarily serves Bilbao, despite being located outside the central city.

The airport is the main international airport serving Barcelona; nearby Catalonia-area airports remain separate city labels where appropriate.
The airport primarily serves Málaga and the surrounding Costa del Sol; the city label is Málaga rather than the broader coastal area.

The airport is the principal airport serving Madrid.
